description: Read web3_sha3 from Ethereum (eip155:1). Costs 0.002500 USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Preserve the private idempotencyKey for retries.

idempotencyKey.description: Private random 32-byte lowercase hex recovery key. Persist before payment and reuse only for retries of this same method and params. Never publish it.

name: ethereum_web3_sha3
